scenario: A credit analyst at an asset management firm reviews a high-yield bond indenture to extract maintenance covenant thresholds (net leverage ratio, interest coverage ratio), computes the issuer's actual ratios from its most recent quarterly financials, and generates a covenant compliance memo for the portfolio manager.
info_flow: pdf-extract reads the bond indenture PDF and outputs plain text containing covenant threshold values → financial-calculator receives the extracted thresholds and the issuer's financial figures to compute net leverage and interest coverage ratios and compare them against the thresholds → reporting assembles the compliance memo with pass/fail verdicts for each covenant.
